Name: ZH's Artisanal Goods Plus
Author: ZoeyHoshi
Description:
[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/QgLDUOO.png[/img]﻿﻿[/center]
With a big update to this mod, it's now a retexture mod for artisan goods and even more, expanding into other non-artisan good items. I made it to work alongside [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/29533/]ZH's EBAGI[/url], to match textures. 

I was inspired by other modders and artists such as [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/birDfiSHi?gameId=1303]DSHi[/url], [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/Gweniaczek?gameId=1303]Gwen[/url], [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/Wildflourmods?gameId=1303]Wildflour[/url], [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/HimeTarts?gameId=1303]Himetarts[/url], [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/mrtaiyou?gameId=1303]Tai [/url]and more.


[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/lcEmWaN.png[/img]﻿
﻿
With the 1.1.0 update, you may be wondering, what [i]is [/i]covered in this mod now?[/center]
[u][b]Artisan Goods:[/b][/u]
Aged Roe (Including Cavier), Beer, Cheese (Including Goat Cheese), Cloth, Dried Mushrooms, Dried Fruit (Including Raisins), Honey, Jelly, Juice, Mayonnaise (All Mayonnaises), Mead, Pale Ale, Pickles, Truffle Oil, Wine

[b][u]Animal Products:[/u][/b]
Milk (All milk sizes and types)

[b][u]Cooking Ingredients:[/u][/b]
Oil, Rice, Sugar, Vinegar, Wheat Flour

[u][b]Craftable Items:[/b][/u]
Life Elixir, Monster Musk, Oil of Garlic

[u][b]Drinks:[/b][/u]
Ginger Ale, Joja Cola, Piña Colada

[b][u]Medicines:[/u][/b]
Energy Tonic, Muscle Remedy

[u][b]Special Items:[/b][/u]
Iridium Snake Milk, Prismatic Jelly, Squid Ink

[u][b]﻿Tree Syrups:[/b][/u]
Maple Syrup, Mystic Syrup, Oak Resin, Pine Tar

This mod, like my others, is completely [i]configurable[/i]. Anything you don't like or want, you can simply disable alongside choose what style and colour you want.
[center][/center]

[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/4fl2KWq.png[/img]﻿[/center]1. Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]﻿
2. Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿
3. Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] for easy configurations
4. Download the main .zip file from this mod and install it
5. When starting the game for the first time since installing, use Generic Mod Config Menu to configure the mod to your liking

You're all done and ready to play.

[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/mTUL7Ne.png[/img][/center]
